label: Daily Reminder
description: Posts a configurable message to a configured room on a cron schedule.

slots.name: roomId
slots.question: Which room should the reminder post in?
slots.hint: The room id. Copy it from the room's settings page.

slots.name: cron
slots.question: When should the reminder fire?
slots.hint: Five-field cron expression. No seconds. No macros.

slots.name: timezone
slots.question: Which timezone should the schedule use?
slots.hint: IANA timezone name, for example Europe/Madrid.

message.label: Reminder message
message.hint: The text posted on each fire. Change it any time from the bot's settings page.

config.text: Daily Reminder is ready. It will post to this room on the configured schedule.

constraints: The room id is fixed at build time. Changing it requires rebuilding the bot.
The reminder posts to the same room regardless of where the bot is granted.
The message is a user-scoped setting. Changing it applies to every room the bot is granted in, but only the configured room receives the reminder.
The scheduler is the runtime's cron engine. Missed fires are skipped unless the operator enables catch-up in the runtime config.
